food.name: Food
food.description: Used to feed your peasants and military units

wood.name: Wood
wood.description: Used for constructing buildings and training units

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Used for advanced buildings and fortifications

iron.name: Iron
iron.description: Used for training elite military units and advanced technologies

tent.name: Tent
tent.description: Basic shelter. Provides housing for 3 peasants.

hut.name: Hut
hut.description: Simple dwelling. Provides housing for 8 peasants.

house.name: House
house.description: Sturdy home. Provides housing for 20 peasants.

farm.name: Farm
farm.description: Produces food. Requires 6 peasants for 100% efficiency. Produces 10 food per turn at full capacity.

lumber_mill.name: Lumber Mill
lumber_mill.description: Produces wood. Requires 6 peasants for 100% efficiency. Produces 8 wood per turn at full capacity.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.description: Produces stone. Requires 8 peasants for 100% efficiency. Produces 6 stone per turn at full capacity.

mine.name: Mine
mine.description: Produces iron. Requires 10 peasants for 100% efficiency. Produces 4 iron per turn at full capacity.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: Trains infantry units. Can hold 15 soldiers (including cavalry). Provides vision of 3 tiles.

archery_range.name: Archery Range
archery_range.description: Trains archers. Can hold 12 foot soldiers only (no cavalry). Provides vision of 4 tiles.

stable.name: Stable
stable.description: Trains cavalry units. Can hold 8 soldiers (including cavalry). Provides vision of 3 tiles.

training_ground.name: Training Ground
training_ground.description: Trains scouts for exploration. Can hold 10 foot soldiers only (no cavalry). Provides vision of 5 tiles.

wood_wall.name: Wood Wall
wood_wall.description: Defensive wall segment. Forms a village when connected in a closed loop with gates. Can hold 10 foot soldiers (no cavalry). Provides vision of 3 tiles.

stone_wall.name: Stone Wall
stone_wall.description: Strong defensive wall segment. Forms a city when connected in a closed loop with gates. Can hold 20 foot soldiers (no cavalry). Provides vision of 4 tiles.

wood_gate.name: Wood Gate
wood_gate.description: Entrance in wood walls. Required for village formation. Cannot station soldiers. Provides vision of 3 tiles.

stone_gate.name: Stone Gate
stone_gate.description: Reinforced entrance in stone walls. Required for city formation. Cannot station soldiers. Provides vision of 4 tiles.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Versatile infantry unit. Balanced attack (10) and defense (8). Moves 3 tiles per turn. Costs 2 food upkeep per turn.

spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description: Defensive infantry unit. Strong against cavalry. High defense (10), moderate attack (8). Moves 3 tiles per turn. Costs 2 food upkeep per turn.

swordsman.name: Swordsman
swordsman.description: Elite heavy infantry. High attack (12), good defense (9). Requires iron. Moves 2 tiles per turn. Costs 3 food upkeep per turn.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Ranged unit. Gets bonus when stationed on walls. Moderate attack (9), low defense (5). Better vision (4 tiles). Costs 2 food upkeep per turn.

horseman.name: Horseman
horseman.description: Fast cavalry unit. CANNOT be stationed on walls. High mobility (5 tiles per turn), strong attack (11). Costs 4 food upkeep per turn.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Exploration unit. Excellent vision (6 tiles) for revealing the map. Very fast (6 tiles per turn), weak in combat. Costs 1 food upkeep per turn.
